shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A woman in a burgundy sweater sits at the sideboard-side window seat and recounts a personal blunder, a man in a navy polo sits at the patio-side window seat, and a woman in an olive cardigan sits at the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in the navy polo asks the woman in the burgundy sweater for further details.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the burgundy sweater answers the man in the navy polo with the resolution.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the dining table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.
